description: Header file declaring functions and macros related to endpoint profile management in the wld module, including delete, fromIt, and hasValidConf functions.

methods.name: wld_epProfile_delete
methods.description: Deletes an endpoint profile given endpoint and profile pointers.

methods.name: wld_epProfile_fromIt
methods.description: Creates an endpoint profile from an iterator.

methods.name: wld_epProfile_hasValidConf
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint profile has a valid configuration.
